SS-RUNTIME-SERVICES.Purpose: Session-level runtime services: the Unity host root object, the behavior ownership registry, and the global tick loop driving subscribed behaviors.

Scope.SCP-IN-001: FlexVerseRoot MonoBehaviour: creation, update pumping, mod entry and settings.
Scope.SCP-IN-002: BehaviorRegistry: reference counting and per-owner subscription ledger.
Scope.SCP-IN-003: BehaviorUpdater: weak-reference tick list with throttling support.
Scope.SCP-OUT-001: Property-slot subscription semantics — owned by SS-PROPERTY-REFS.

Principles.PRIN-001: Services are process singletons reachable from any mod without service location by user code.

Requirements.REQ-001: The root survives scene loads and never duplicates across mod reloads.
Requirements.REQ-002: Tick order is stable: registry bookkeeping runs before behavior updates each frame.
